metadata.tags: Industrial electronica, cinematic darksynth; dark, cold, nocturnal production with vast negative space and roomy, unprocessed hook harmonies that spread in stereo; 138 bpm half-time stride in a minor key; first vocal within seconds, low intimate baritone and restrained talk-singing; saturated detuned analog sub-bass, dry crushing kick, cavernous snare, ticking metallic percussion, cold granular pads; compact 2:40 arrangement with a stripped bridge and short natural ending.

[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Lights out on the ninetieth floor
Nobody lives here anymore
But the stairwell hums the way you climbed
One step heavy, one step light

[Pre-Chorus]
